reference_sql:
WITH store_units AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, units,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY units DESC) AS place
  FROM store_units
)
SELECT store_code,
       SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE place <= 3) AS top_units,
       SUM(units) AS store_units,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE place <= 3) / SUM(units), 1) AS top_share_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY store_code

WITH store_units AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
),
placed AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT su.store_code, su.units,
         1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_units su2 WHERE su2.store_code = su.store_code AND su2.units > su.units) AS place
  FROM store_units su
)
SELECT store_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN place <= 3 THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS top_units,
       SUM(units) AS store_units,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN place <= 3 THEN units ELSE 0 END) / SUM(units), 1) AS top_share_pct
FROM placed
GROUP BY store_code

  SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units

  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY store_code, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per store and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, units,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY units DESC) AS place
  FROM store_units
),
top AS (  -- one row per store with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, SUM(units) AS top_units
  FROM ranked
  WHERE place <= 3
  GROUP BY store_code
),
total AS (  -- one row per store with sales in 2025
  SELECT store_code, SUM(units) AS store_units
  FROM store_units
  GROUP BY store_code
)
SELECT t.store_code, t.top_units, a.store_units, ROUND(100.0 * t.top_units / a.store_units, 1) AS top_share_pct
FROM top t
JOIN total a ON a.store_code = t.store_code

WITH p AS (SELECT store_code, product_id, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY store_code, product_id),
r AS (SELECT store_code, units, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY units DESC) AS place FROM p),
t AS (SELECT store_code, SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE place <= 3) AS top_units, SUM(units) AS store_units FROM r GROUP BY store_code)
SELECT store_code, top_units, store_units, ROUND(100.0 * top_units / store_units, 1) AS top_share_pct FROM t
